name: UI — Ícono de Bala (HUD contador de munición)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo ícono centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 24×24.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon HUD icon centered on a fully transparent background. The icon is a BULLET / PROJECTILE icon for a game HUD counter. A fat chunky cartoon bullet cartridge shape — wide brass body tapering to a rounded glowing tip. Warm gold-brass body (#C8940A) with cel-shading: bright yellow-gold highlight on the upper left, warm gold midtone, dark amber shadow. The bullet tip glows bright warm white-yellow (#FFFFA0) with a small radiant glow aura. Bold dark charcoal outline, 4-5px. The shape is INSTANTLY readable as a bullet even at 24x24px — thick, bold, iconic. No background, no scene, only the bullet icon floating centered. Transparent background.
frames.negative_prompt: background, scenery, realistic, photorealistic, pixel art, sphere, coin, round circle only, gun, rifle, wall, brick, text, watermark, complex detail

phaser_config.notes: HUD. N activos alpha 1.0 + (max-N) alpha 0.2. Max = 15.
